entities.name: Query Mur ligase
observations: 480 aa soluble enzyme-like protein with predicted molecular weight 50.9 kDa and theoretical pI 5.61.
Contains Pfam Mur_ligase (PF01225), Mur_ligase_M (PF08245), and Mur_ligase_C (PF02875) domains.
Strongly matches reviewed Mur ligase homologs Q0AYR3, Q182Z8, and Q39YM4 at 39.4–41.8% identity with 89.2–92.7% query coverage.

entities.name: MurE ligase
observations: Reviewed homologs annotate this enzyme as UDP-N-acetylmuramoyl-L-alanyl-D-glutamate--2,6-diaminopimelate ligase.
The enzyme is an ATP-dependent cytoplasmic peptidoglycan-biosynthesis ligase and uses Mg2+.
Reference annotations assign EC 6.3.2.13 and GO terms for ATP binding, magnesium binding, and MurE ligase activity.

entities.name: MurE ligase reaction
observations: Reaction is mapped to Rhea RHEA:23676 and EC 6.3.2.13 in reviewed homolog annotations.

entities.name: Peptidoglycan biosynthesis
observations: MurE ligase catalyzes incorporation of meso-diaminopimelate into the UDP-MurNAc-tripeptide precursor during bacterial cell-wall peptidoglycan biosynthesis.
